name: CBOE Volatility Index
blurb: The VIX is the Chicago Board Options Exchange's volatility index, derived from S&P 500 options prices to estimate expected 30-day volatility. Often called the market's "fear gauge," it rises during selloffs and falls during calm uptrends. The index itself isn't directly investable; tradeable products include VIX futures, VXX/VIXY ETFs, UVXY (leveraged), and SVXY (inverse).
recent: Through 2025-2026 the VIX moved between roughly 13 and 60, spiking in April 2025 (the so-called Liberation Day shock) and again during the late-2025 mega-cap drawdown that took the AI complex off ~25% from its highs.
